buffer.sense: A block of memory Cmdr keeps filled ahead of use (the viewer's prefetch buffer, the list's virtualization buffer, the type-to-jump buffer, the file watcher's event buffer).

column.sense: A column of the file list (Name, Size, Ext) or one column of Brief view's multi-column layout.

empty-trash.sense: Permanently deleting everything in the macOS Trash (Finder's Empty Trash).

forget.sense: Dropping something Cmdr remembers (a saved server, a saved password, Ask Cmdr's notes about the user) without touching any files.

home-folder.sense: The user's home folder (/Users/<name>), the Go menu's Home item and the way out of an error screen.

network.sense: A computer network in general (the Mac's connection, a server being on the same network) and the volume switcher's Network group.

offline.sense: Whether a cloud file's contents are on the Mac (available offline) or only on the provider's servers (online-only); also a host being back online.

open-with.sense: Opening a file in a chosen app: the Open With submenu, and opening with the default app.

placeholder.sense: A stand-in to replace with a real value: the example text in an input field, or a token in a format string (YYYY, MM).
placeholder.note: Two senses under one English word; a language may need two words (a field's example text vs a format token).

platform-tools.sense: Google's Android SDK platform-tools package, which provides the adb command.

regex.sense: A regular-expression search or selection pattern, and the Regex mode of the search and selection bars.

removable.sense: A drive macOS can eject and the user can unplug (as opposed to an internal disk).

reset.sense: Putting a setting, a shortcut, or the zoom level back to its default value.
reset.note: Not a connection being reset by the network (a restart of the connection).

similar.sense: Image-similarity search: finding pictures that look like a given one.

status.sense: A state readout: a license's status, a server's Status column, a model's status line, a sync or git status, a status badge.

step.sense: One numbered stage of the onboarding wizard, a setup guide, or an install (Step 2 of 4).

store.sense: Where data or a name physically lives (a destination that can't store a name, a file stored on a drive, a password stored in the keychain).

window.sense: An app window (Cmdr's main window, the About window, the queue window) and the Window menu.
